column1: Subject + (已经) + Duration + 没 + Verb + 了
column3: have not done something for a period of time (已经 can be omitted)
column4: 你已经一个月没跟爸爸妈妈视频聊天了。
column5: You haven't had a video chat with Mom and Dad for a month.

column3: besides / in addition to ... (with 都 it means "except")
column4: 除了上课以外,我也参加了两个社团,另外还想找实习。
column5: Besides attending classes, I also joined two clubs, and I also want to find an internship.

column1: Subject + 一点(儿) + 也/都 + 不 + Adj./Verb Phrase
column4: 你们俩一点都不关心父母!
column5: You two don't care about your parents at all!

column3: quite / rather / pretty (adjective); common in spoken Chinese
column4: 她跟哥哥很谈得来。看起来挺有气质的。
column5: She gets along well with her brother and looks pretty cultivated.

column3: be able to talk to; get along well with
column5: She gets along well with her brother.

column3: intensifies an adjective with an unpleasant connotation ("... to death")
column5: I am really worried to death.

column3: lower/higher than ...; 于 follows an adjective to indicate comparison, with the same meaning as 比
column5: Grades cannot be lower than A.

column3: A is not as adj. as B
column4: 我的父母没有蔡美儿那么严格。
column5: My parents are not as strict as Amy Chua.

column2: ná A gēn B zuò bǐjiào
column4: 父母喜欢拿我跟"别人家的孩子"做比较。
column5: My parents like to compare me with "other people's kids".

column3: as soon as / once / whenever action 1 happens, action 2 happens
column4: 王阿姨的儿子一毕业就拿到了年薪10万美金的工作。
column5: Upon graduation, Aunt Wang's son got a job with an annual salary of 100,000 U.S. dollars.

column3: make sacrifice for ... / the sacrifice made for ...
column4: 另一些压力来自于父母为我的教育做出的牺牲。
column5: Other pressures came from the sacrifices my parents made for my education.

column4: 在这些压力下,父母的关心和爱却成了我的负担。
column5: Under these pressures, the care and love of my parents became my burden.
